question: Which of the following power projects is based on nuclear energy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalpakkam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Kalpakkam Power Plant**, also known as the Madras Atomic Power Station (MAPS), is a nuclear power station. It is located in **Kalpakkam, Tamil Nadu**, India.
 
• The plant is operated by the **Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL)**, which is responsible for operating nuclear power plants in the country.
 
• Kalpakkam has two reactors with a capacity of **220 MW each**, which are part of India’s indigenous Pressurized Heavy Water Reactor (PHWR) program.
 
• The plant uses nuclear energy to produce electricity. Nuclear energy is generated through nuclear fission, where the nucleus of an atom splits into smaller parts, releasing energy in the process.
